The choice of preparation for the determination of alternaria toxins from wheat by LC-MS / MS

In summary, our research is concerned with
choosing the most suitable method for sample preparation for determination of Alternaria mycotox in wheat samples.
the choice of preparation methods for the determination of alternariol, tenuazonc acid and alternariol monometyl ether in wheat samples by LC–MS/MS technique.
the choice of the most appropriate sample preparation method for the extraction of Alternaria toxins (alternariol, alternariaol monomethyl ethers, tenuazonol) from wheat samples by using LC-MS/ MS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the modified method of sample preparation is acceptable for the analysis of Alternaria toxins by LC-MSMS.
the modified method of wheat samples extraction by ethyl acetate is the best preparation method for determination of Alternaria metabolites by LC-MS-MS technique.

the method developed and optimized in this study could be successfully applied for the determination of alternariol, alterna-riol monomethyl, tenuazon, alternariol methyl ether, alterna-rioic acid and altenuene in wheat samples.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the most suitable method for extraction and cleanup of wheat samples for analysis of Alternaria toxins by LC-MSMS is extraction with ethylacetate and cleanup with Florisil.
the method for the determination and quantification of mycotoxin alternariol and alternariol monometil ether from wheat samples was developed and validated.

a modified sample preparation method by extraction with ethacetic acid, with the use of QuEChERS method for cleanup, is a suitable method for the determination and quantification of alternariol, tenuazonol, alternariols monomethyl ether and alternariols dimethyl ether in wheat samples.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the choice of preparation method is a key step in the analysis of Alternaria toxins, and it can affect the results of the analysis.
the choice of the preparation method is of great importance for the determination of mycotoxin levels in wheat samples.

it is necessary to choose the most appropriate method for the preparation of the samples in accordance with the matrix, the type of mycotoxin and their chemical properties, and the analytical method used for their detection.
